title: Món này có trứng hay đậu phộng không?
englishTitle: Does this have egg or peanuts?
pronunciation: mon nai koh choong hai dow fohng khong
summary: Ask about egg or peanuts when the exact ingredient matters before you eat.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use this before ordering or eating when egg or peanuts would change the decision.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Say this while pointing at a dish, menu photo, or tray.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Món này means this dish; có asks whether it contains something; trứng hay đậu phộng names egg or peanuts.

breakdown.vietnamese: Món này có trứng hay đậu phộng không?

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: For serious allergies, keep the allergy phrase visible too. This line is an ingredient check, not a full medical warning.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best when the ingredient matters and you need a yes/no answer before choosing.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: For allergies, wait for a clear answer and choose another dish if the kitchen seems unsure.
